label: Digi One SP serial-to-Ethernet device server
description: Compact single-port serial server: one DB9M RS-232/422/485 port bridged to a 10/100Base-T Ethernet port - the classic one-console-port-to-Ethernet adapter.
notes: 1 x DB9M switch-selectable RS-232/422/485 up to 230 kbps + 1 x 10/100Base-T. TCP/UDP sockets, RealPort COM redirector, SSH/Telnet sockets, Modbus TCP-to-RTU, modem emulation. 1/2/4-port siblings in the Digi One and PortServer TS families; the IA variant is the DIN-rail industrial version with the same DB9 port.
